What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:

Our return policy applies to Dermalogica.com purchases only.

We gladly accept returns for any reason within 30 days of your order date; the return process must be initiated within those 30 days to receive a refund.
Return shipping, handling, and restocking fees are not charged when you use our provided label.
Only new or gently used items in original packaging are eligible. Products that are nearly empty, damaged or lost from personal use, or tampered with/filled with other substances are not refundable.
Certain items are final sale and non-returnable: partial kits or gift sets, free samples, gifts with purchase, and rewards items.
To return, visit our online returns center, enter your order number (starting with “S”) and shipping ZIP code, select items to return, confirm, then print and use the prepaid UPS label. Include the packing slip and drop the package at UPS. Once received, we’ll process your refund or replacement.
If you choose not to keep an order that has already been processed and shipped, you can still use the returns center and prepaid label to receive a full refund for all items marked for return once they’re received.
Any points earned from a returned purchase will be reversed or decreased; if that return causes you to drop a tier, your tier will be adjusted.
If you purchased through a salon, spa, or other website, you must follow their return policy directly, as our policy only covers Dermalogica.com orders.
